text:
lina: FYI onboarding template is broken for new users: Node quickstart hitting 400 for /v1/chat/completions when passing `system_message` field.
omar: We changed REST to `system_prompt` a while back. SDK still sends `system_message`. Validator rejects it.
linA: Can repro in sampleapp. Short diff shows api-client/src/chat.ts maps `systemMessage` -> `system_message`. Should map to `system_prompt`.
devkit-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for `accept-system_message-alias` by omar.
jen-support: Impact: multiple signups failed onboarding in the last 24h. Adding KB note and notifying affected customers.
omar: Also found a retry discrepancy: REST returns 503 with Retry-After when runtime is overloaded. JS SDK currently treats 503 as fatal unless opted-in. Propose: SDK should retry 429/503 by default with exponential backoff and jitter.
lina: Action items: 1) Patch JS SDK serialization mapping (systemMessage -> system_prompt) + unit test (omar). 2) Add short-lived server alias accepting `system_message` with deprecation warning for 2 releases (eng-runtime). 3) Update SDK docs about retry policy and ensure default includes 503/429 (devkit). 4) Add E2E CI test that runs quickstart flow against canary.
jen-support: :white_check_mark: I'll update KB and CS runbook.
lina: Opening GH issues and PRs now; will post links here when ready.
